## Introduction

This vignette provides an introduction to the `{qnp}` package,
which provides helpers for including plots in Quarto notes.

## Basic Usage

`interactive_plot()` makes a `ggplot` interactive in HTML output
and leaves it unchanged in other output formats.
The `alt` argument gives a text alternative for screen readers:

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +
  geom_point()

interactive_plot(
  plot = p,
  alt = "Scatterplot of fuel economy versus car weight"
)
```
